# API reference

This is a working reference for the public API. All of it is fully typed (`lib/index.d.ts`).

```ts
import makeWASocket, {
  useMultiFileAuthState, makeCacheableSignalKeyStore, Browsers, DisconnectReason,
  fetchLatestBaileysVersion, fetchLatestWaWebVersion,
  makeInMemoryStore,                    // (where available)
  proto,                                // the whole WhatsApp protobuf namespace
  // utils
  getContentType, normalizeMessageContent, extractMessageContent, BufferJSON,
  jidDecode, jidEncode, jidNormalizedUser, areJidsSameUser,
  // hardening helpers (new)
  withTimeout, withRetry, settle, safeAllSettled, TimeoutError,
  isWAMessage, sanitizeIncomingMessage, getMessageTypeInfo, getMessageContentKeys,
} from '@chaeulso/baileys'

// type imports
import type {
  WAMessage, WAMessageContent, WAMessageKey, WASocket,
  AnyMessageContent, AnyRegularMessageContent, MiscMessageGenerationOptions,
  BaileysEventMap, BaileysEventEmitter, ConnectionState, Contact, GroupMetadata,
  SocketConfig, WASocket as Sock
} from '@chaeulso/baileys'
```

---

## `makeWASocket(config?)`

Creates a WhatsApp connection and returns a `WASocket`.

```ts
const sock = makeWASocket(config: SocketConfig): WASocket
```

### `SocketConfig` (selected)

| Field | Type / default | Description |
| ----- | -------------- | ----------- |
| `version` | `WAVersion` | WhatsApp Web version; pass `fetchLatestBaileysVersion()` result |
| `auth` | `AuthenticationState` | from `useMultiFileAuthState` |
| `printQRInTerminal` | `boolean` | print QR to terminal |
| `browser` | `Browsers.BrowsersMap`  | client fingerprint, e.g. `['chaeulso','Chrome','1.0']` |
| `browser` (alt) | `string` | or `Browsers.ubuntu('Chrome')` etc. |
| `logger` | `ILogger` | pino logger; default child logger |
| `emitOwnEvents` | `boolean` (true) | whether to emit events for your own actions |
| `connectTimeoutMs` | `ms` | WS connect timeout |
| `defaultQueryTimeoutMs` | `ms \| undefined` | per-query timeout; `undefined` = no timeout |
| `keepAliveIntervalMs` | `ms` | WS keepalive ping interval |
| `qrTimeout` | `ms` | QR refresh interval |
| `maxMsgRetryCount` | `number` | message retry limit |
| `retryRequestDelayMs` | `ms` | base delay between retries |
| `markOnlineOnConnect` | `boolean` | set presence online when connected |
| `syncFullHistory` | `boolean` | request full message history on login |
| `shouldSyncHistoryMessage` | `(msg) => boolean` | filter which history messages to process |
| `transactionOpts` | `{ maxCommitRetries, delayBetweenTriesMs }` | app-state transaction tuning |
| `shouldIgnoreJid` / `getMessage` | various | store hooks |

> Full type in `lib/Types/Socket.d.ts` (`SocketConfig`).

---

## `WASocket`

`sock` is composed of several mixins. Public members include:

### Core / connection

| Member | Purpose |
| ------ | ------- |
| `sock.ev` | `BaileysEventEmitter` — `.on/.off/.emit(...)` + buffering (buffer/flush) |
| `sock.ws` | underlying `WebSocketClient` (send/receive/query) |
| `sock.authState` | current `AuthenticationState` (creds + keys) |
| `sock.signalRepository` | Signal/E2EE repository (create / migrate sessions) |
| `sock.user` | connected user info (`{ id, lid? }`) once authorized |
| `sock.logout()` | invalidate session on the phone side |
| `sock.end(err?)` | close the connection |
| `sock.requestPairingCode(phoneNumber)` | get a 8‑digit pairing code |
| `sock.waitForSocketOpen()` | await the WS handshake |
| `sock.query(node)` | low‑level WABinary query |
| `sock.relayMessage(jid, message, opts)` | send a pre‑built message (used by sendMessage) |
| `sock.assertSessions(jids, robust)` | ensure Signal sessions exist for JIDs |

### Messaging

| Method | Purpose |
| ------ | ------- |
| `sock.sendMessage(jid, content, opts?)` | send any message; returns `WebMessageInfo` |
| `sock.updateMediaMessage(msg)` | re‑upload expired media on a message |
| `sock.rejectCall(callId, callFrom)` | reject an incoming call |
| `sock.readMessages(keys)` | send read receipts / blue ticks |
| `sock.sendReceipts(keys, type)` | low‑level receipts |
| `sock.sendPresenceUpdate('paused'\|'available'\|'unavailable'\|..., toJid?)` | set presence |
| `sock.presenceSubscribe(jid)` | subscribe to a contact's presence updates |
| `sock.processMessage(msg)` | internal: process a raw decrypted message (events) |
| `sock.downloadHistory(prcMessage)` | fetch encrypted history for a message |

Common `AnyMessageContent` shorthands (passed to `sendMessage`):

```ts
{ text }                    // conversation
{ extendedTextMessage }     // rich text
{ image, caption, viewOnce }, { video, caption, gifPlayback }, { audio, mimetype, ptt },
{ document, mimetype, fileName }, { sticker },
{ location: { degreesLatitude, degreesLongitude, ... } }, { liveLocation },
{ contacts: { displayName, contacts: [{ vcard }] } },
{ react: { text, key } },
{ poll: { name, values, selectableCount } },
{ delete: key }, { edit: key, text }, { forward: message }, { keep: { key, type } }, { pin: { key, type, time } },
{ buttons, text, footer }, { listMessage }? (as AnyMessageContent primitives),
{ sections, buttonText, text, title, footer }   // list message factory
```

> `AnyMessageContent` is the exact typed shape — see `lib/Types/Message.d.ts` (`AnyRegularMessageContent`, `MiscMessageGenerationOptions`, plus generation helpers like `generateWAMessage`, `generateWAMessageFromContent`, `prepareWAMessageMedia`, `provideWAMessageUploadHook`).

### Chats / contacts / receipts

| Method | Purpose |
| ------ | ------- |
| `sock.chatModify(mods, jid)` | archive/pin/mute/mark‑read/delete/star/disappear/clear a chat |
| `sock.fetchMessageHistory(count, oldestMsgKey, oldestMsgTimestamp?)` | pull chat history |
| `sock.resyncAppState(collection)` | resync app state collections |
| `sock.onWhatsApp(...jids)` | check which jids are on WhatsApp |
| `sock.fetchStatus(jid)` | `about` status of a contact |
| `sock.fetchBlocklist()` | your blocklist |
| `sock.fetchDisappearingDuration(jid)` | chat's disappearing timer |
| `sock.getPrivacySettings()`/`fetchPrivacySettings()` | your privacy settings |
| `sock.updateBlockStatus(jid, 'block'\|'unblock')` | via `chatModify` |

### Profile & business

| Method | Purpose |
| ------ | ------- |
| `sock.updateProfileName(name)` / `updateProfileStatus(status)` | set profile fields |
| `sock.updateProfilePicture(jid, content)` / `removeProfilePicture(jid)` | set/remove avatar |
| `sock.getBusinessProfile(jid)` | business profile info |
| `sock.getCatalog`/`getCollections`/`getOrderDetails`/`productCreate`/`productUpdate`/`productDelete` | catalog/product management |

### Groups

`groupAcceptInvite`, `groupCreate(subject, participants[])`, `groupLeave(jid)`, `groupMetadata(jid)` — resolve group info (cached hint), `groupUpdateSubject`, `groupUpdateDescription`, `groupSettingUpdate(jid, 'announcement'|'not_announcement'|'locked'|'unlocked')`, `groupParticipantsUpdate(jid, ids[], 'add'|'remove'|'promote'|'demote')`, `groupInviteCode`, `groupRevokeInvite`, `groupGetInviteInfo(code)`, `groupToggleEphemeral`, `groupMemberAddMode`, `groupRequestParticipantsList`, `groupRequestParticipantsUpdate`, `joinApprovalMode`.

### Newsletters (channels)

`newsletterCreate`, `newsletterMetadata`, `newsletterSubscribers`, `newsletterAdminCount`, `newsletterFollow`/`newsletterUnfollow`, `newsletterMute`/`newsletterUnmute`, `newsletterUpdateName`/`newsletterUpdateDescription`/`newsletterUpdatePicture`/`newsletterRemovePicture`, `newsletterChangeOwner`, `newsletterDemote`, `newsletterDelete`, `newsletterFetchMessages`, `newsletterReactMessage`.

## Auth helpers

### `useMultiFileAuthState(folder)`

Stores session in JSON files. Returns `{ state, saveCreds }`. Wire `sock.ev.on('creds.update', saveCreds)`. For REST/db persistence, serialize with `BufferJSON`:

```ts
const tmp = JSON.stringify(state.creds, BufferJSON.replacer)      // -> string for DB
const creds = JSON.parse(dbValue, BufferJSON.reviver)             // -> restore
```

### `makeCacheableSignalKeyStore(store?, logger?)`

Wraps a Signal key store with an in‑memory cache so repeated lookups don't hit disk.

### `initAuthCreds()` / `addTransactionCapability(store, logger, opts)`

Low-level helpers (used internally and by certain session flows).

## Utilities (a selection)

| Helpers | Purpose |
| ------- | ------- |
| `getContentType` / `normalizeMessageContent` / `extractMessageContent` | parse message content (flexible, future-proof) |
| `jidDecode` / `jidEncode` / `jidNormalizedUser` / `areJidsSameUser` | JID helpers |
| `isJidGroup` / `isJidBroadcast` / `isJidNewsletter` / `isPnUser` / `isLidUser` | JID classifiers |
| `BufferJSON` | JSON replacer/reviver that round‑trips buffers — how sessions/messages persist |
| `generateMessageID` / `generateMessageIDV2` | unique message ids |
| `sha256` / `hmacSign` / `md5` / `aesEncryptGCM` / `aesDecryptGCM` | crypto |
| `signedKeyPair` / `generateSignalPubKey` / `Curve` | Signal crypto primitives |
| `assertNodeErrorFree` / `getBinaryNodeChild` / `getBinaryNodeChildren` | WABinary response helpers |
| `encodeBinaryNode` / `decodeBinaryNode` | WABinary wire codec |
| `getUrlInfo` | link previews |
| `delay` / `delayCancellable` / `debouncedTimeout` / `promiseTimeout` | async utilities |

Full list = `Object.keys(require('@chaeulso/baileys'))` (273 exports).

## Hardening helpers (new)

```ts
withTimeout(promise, ms, errorFactory?)      // bounded operation -> TimeoutError
withRetry(fn, { retries, baseDelayMs, maxDelayMs, factor, jitter, isRetryable, onRetry, signal })
settle(promises)                             // Promise.all that never throws (undefined on failure)
safeAllSettled(promises)                     // allSettled, pre-guarded against unhandled rejections
isWAMessage(x)                               // structural validation (shape-only, shape-safe)
isValidMessageKey(key)
getMessageContentKeys(content)               // schema-key-driven (non-switch) type keys
getMessageTypeInfo(content)                  // { outerType, innerType, isMedia, isViewOnce, isEphemeral, isEdited, protocol }
sanitizeIncomingMessage(wam)                 // return normalized msg or null
```

## `proto`

The full protobuf namespace (`WAProto`) — every message type (`proto.Message.ImageMessage`, `proto.WebMessageInfo`, …) with `create`, `fromObject`, `toObject`, `encode`, `decode`.
